US and China compete on AI and data infrastructure

The United States and China are engaged in a competition to lead in artificial intelligence (AI) and the underlying data infrastructure. While the US is seen as leading in AI development, China is reportedly focusing on building the robotic and physical infrastructure to support it. The coverage suggests a race to develop and control the technological future, with implications for global leadership.
